# Adams Bilal — Web Developer

> Portfolio site for Adams Bilal, a web developer working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Python, and Node.js.

## Pages
- [Home](https://adamsbilal.netlify.app/): Introduction and skills overview.
- [Projects](https://adamsbilal.netlify.app/projects.html): Selected work, including Sabr Scents (a fragrance brand website).
- [About](https://adamsbilal.netlify.app/about.html): How Adams works and his toolkit.
- [Contact](https://adamsbilal.netlify.app/contact.html): Email, WhatsApp, TikTok, and Instagram.
